why_relevant: Programme office under MDT; useful mainly as a pointer to EU-funded digital infrastructure programmes and their procurement pipelines, and to MDT's project-office structure.

source_name: Municipal legacy/archive procurement pages (e.g. Општина Велес архива)
why_relevant: Demonstrates the common pattern outside Skopje: smaller municipalities keep their own (often archived, often stale) tender pages in parallel with ЕСЈН. Valuable for historical award records that have aged out of the national portal's front-end.

source_name: Asseco SEE / ASEE (Payten) — AmCham Macedonia member profile & group site
why_relevant: ASEE Group is the region's largest banking-software and payments (Payten brand) supplier and is present in MK (NLB mKlik/mProKlik apps are Asseco-built); its local entity is a prime competitor/partner for bank IT and POS estates.

entity_name: Commercial tender aggregators covering North Macedonia
source_name: Commercial tender aggregators covering North Macedonia (GlobalTenders, TendersInfo, MacedoniaTenders, TenderImpulse, SellToState)
why_relevant: Paywalled English-language resellers of ESJN content. Not a substitute for the primary source, but useful as (a) a cross-check that a notice exists when ESJN blocks a fetch, (b) an English-translated CPV/keyword index that makes discovery easier, and (c) evidence of which MK tenders foreign vendors are actually tracking. Contract-award sections are the most useful part.

entity_name: Commercial tender aggregators covering North Macedonia
source_name: GlobalTenders / TendersOnTime — Balkans and EBRD-funded tender feeds
why_relevant: Second-tier commercial aggregators with Balkan and funding-agency (EBRD) cross-sections. Useful mainly as a redundancy layer: if a notice vanished from the MK portal but was mirrored by one of these, the metadata survives.

source_name: zk.mk — директориум на институции и организации
why_relevant: Third-party MK organisation directory carrying entries for MBA, DKZJN and similar bodies — a cheap cross-check/aliasing source for official names and contact data.

Mainstream MK portal; carried the launch/positioning coverage of Faktor.mk itself, illustrating its role as a meta-reporter on the business-media landscape, and covers corporate/economic news generally. Secondary confirmation and outlet-discovery value.

entity_name: Commercial tender aggregators covering North Macedonia
source_name: Commercial tender aggregators covering North Macedonia (tenderdetail, tender-service, tendersinfo, selltostate/Hook)
why_relevant: English-language mirrors/alerting layers over ESJN. Useful as a cross-check and for early alerting, but they are derivative, often incomplete, and paywalled — never a substitute for ESJN itself.

source_name: Duna Computers (ДУНА) — Skopje integrator, ULTIMA software
why_relevant: Three-decade MK integrator with own ULTIMA business software and operations in AL/RS/XK; a likely bidder/deliverer on bank back-office and infrastructure work. Social/news channels carry delivery claims.

source_name: Kariera.mk — business/IT sector rankings and company features
why_relevant: Publishes MK-language features ranking domestically owned IT companies; useful supplementary actor-map input and an early indicator of which vendors are scaling (hiring, revenue) around banking projects.

source_name: Licentium — North Macedonia licensing hub (commercial advisory)
why_relevant: Advisory-firm summaries of the MK PI/EMI regime (capital, fees, NBRNM process) give a fast English orientation and, importantly, indicate advisory demand — a proxy for how many applicants are in the pipeline. Commercially motivated, so verify against NBRSM.

entity_name: Open Data Macedonia / GetData mirrors of ДКСК datasets
source_name: Open Data Macedonia / GetData mirrors of ДКСК datasets
why_relevant: Third-party mirrors that have historically re-published ДКСК registers in machine-readable form. Valuable as a fallback when the institutional site restructures and old URLs break, and as a source of historical snapshots.

source_name: Sparkasse Bank Makedonija — About us / Sale of property
why_relevant: The only 'call for offers' style publication found on this bank's site is foreclosed-asset sales, not procurement — a useful negative benchmark and a demonstration that MK banks use оглас/повик only for selling, not buying. Still worth tracking because the same page template is where a procurement call would appear if ever published.

source_name: Steiermärkische Sparkasse — corporate site / Sparkassengruppe institute list
why_relevant: Direct parent-side estate for Sparkasse Bank MK. Useful for confirming which group service companies (IT, cards, processing) are shared across the Verbund and therefore likely to be imposed on the Skopje subsidiary rather than tendered locally.

source_name: TendersInfo — Balkan region tenders / contract awards
why_relevant: English-language commercial aggregator with a dedicated Balkan-region view including a separate contract-awards section. Its value here is regional cross-referencing and award-notice retention, not primary authority — items are republished, so provenance must always be traced back to the national source.
Additional MK job aggregator; extra coverage layer for bank/vendor postings not mirrored elsewhere.

Practitioner-oriented MK procurement resource with training material on appeal procedures and procedural mechanics. Useful for glossary building and for understanding deadlines/thresholds that govern how quickly a notice must be captured.

Citizen corruption-reporting channel run jointly by Transparency International – Macedonia and the Center for International Relations (email, web app, phone, hashtag #korupcijaMK). Reported cases sometimes concern tender procedures and give early, ground-level signals that never enter the official portal. Low structure, high noise — treat as a lead generator, not a dataset.
